## Standing operator rules
- Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” steps in order, one at a time.
- Any new secret reference in `config/secrets.yaml` must use `vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY>` and never an environment-variable placeholder.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix nightly reconciliation refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The tenacity refactor is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Current payments host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and shut down.
- Currency: Decimal, `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- CLI currency destination is `args.currency`; nested `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Webhook-handler retry decorator with five attempts: caused duplicate customer emails.

## Plan and progress
- Webhook steps 1–5 are done; next: `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`.
- Ruff found E501 at `ledgerly/cli.py:117` and `:203`; fix pending, then rerun `ruff check ledgerly/cli.py tests/test_cli.py`.
- Worker and CLI test suites currently pass.
